episodes.synopsis: Suzume, a working maid from the UK, is told to stay in Japan for a year since Master's mansion collapsed.
episodes.title: Taiyaki, Takoyaki, Odango, Convenience Store Onigiri, and Baumkuchen

episodes.synopsis: Sora is curious why Suzume stares at him. It turns out, she was eyeing the ice cream he was eating.
episodes.title: Ice Cream, Tian Cha, Bolo, Kikyou Shingen Mochi, and Melon Pan

episodes.synopsis: Suzume visits her favorite prepared foods store, tries instant curry, and boils fava beans for the first time.
episodes.title: Prepared Foods, Instant Curry, Fava Beans, Pickled Vegetables, and Ion Supply Drinks

episodes.synopsis: Ricotta comes to Japan to check on Suzume on Master's behalf. Suzume befriends another neighbor, Sato-san.
episodes.title: Biscuits, Anpan, Lemonade, and Fried Chicken

episodes.synopsis: Suzume enjoys the end of the rainy season with hydrangea soft serve and then prepares plum wine at Grandma's.
episodes.title: Soft Serve, Plum Wine, Barley Tea, Crepe, and Raw Egg Over Rice

episodes.synopsis: Suzume enjoys eel with Grandpa and Grandma on a special day. Then she gets lost at the summer festival.
episodes.title: Eel, Cold Tofu, and the Festival

episodes.synopsis: Ricotta invites Suzume to go to the pool, but the pool is closed! Suzume gets shaved ice to cheer them up.
episodes.title: Shaved Ice, Cheesecake, Plain Hot Water, and Cup Noodles

episodes.synopsis: Suzume cooks new rice in a clay pot with Grandma. She invites Ricotta and Nana over to enjoy a special curry.
episodes.title: New Rice, Curry, Roasted Sweet Potatoes, Grapes, and Menchi Katsu

episodes.synopsis: Suzume attempts to cut her bangs for the first time ever and fails. Grandma serves miso soup to cheer her up.
episodes.title: Miso Soup, Ginkgo, and Halloween

episodes.synopsis: Suzume is curious about the special candy the girl has at the park and goes hiking to enjoy the autumn leaves.
episodes.title: Thousand-Year Candy, Corn Soup, Hiking, Mikan, and Meat Bun

episodes.synopsis: Christmas season is here! Suzume serves stollen to Nana and Anzu because they've never had it before.
episodes.title: Stollen, Persimmon, Yuzu, and Christmas Cake

episodes.synopsis: It's the end of the year! Suzume makes dried daikon and enjoys year-end soba with Ricotta, Anzu and Nana.
episodes.title: Gyoza, Dried Daikon, Instant Noodles, and Year-End Soba
